title: Kids' Allowance and Savings Ledger
dataSources: Baby feeds (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), chore completions (`chore:completion`), allowance ledger (`allowance:ledger`), family calendar (`family:calendar`), growth measurements (`growth:measurement`).
app: Baby-tracking apps (Huckleberry/Baby Daybook exports), chore and allowance boards, shared family calendars, and growth logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=allowance:ledger
| stats sum(eval(if(amount>0,amount,0))) as earned, sum(eval(if(amount<0,abs(amount),0))) as spent by child
| eval balance=earned-spent
| sort - balance
description: Keeps a running balance of each child's pocket money, earnings, and spending to teach saving with a real ledger.
value: A visible balance turns allowance into a lesson; kids grasp saving and spending far faster when they can watch it add up.
implementation: Log allowance and purchases to `index=personal`; review each child's earned, spent, and balance.
visualization: Bar chart of balance by child with earned and spent.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps track of each child's pocket money, what they earned and spent, to help them learn about saving.
